title: Bloodhound's Regression Instinct
altTitles: The Returning Instinct of a Hound
The Return Instinct of the Hunting Dog
El instinto de regresión del sabueso
description: "Yan," the protagonist, was brainwashed by the emperor and lived as his puppet. After discovering that he was being manipulated by the emperor, he planned to seek revenge, but was ultimately defeated by the emperor's overwhelming power. Believing he had died, Yan awakens to discover that he has regressed to the time when he was still a recruit. Now he must choose between taking revenge on the emperor or finding his family.
author: Acro
